Club X: before season 2

From season 2 on, before your first signing, three of your XI are taken by other sides. Both run on the real squad screen (shown here with a sample XI). Tap Replay to watch again. The clubs and players in the summary are examples.

A. Sold off

Your idea. A gold £ coin lands on a card, spins faster and faster, then bursts in a flash of sparks. The card goes up in smoke, leaving an empty shirt. Three in a row, then a short summary.

B. Poached

A different take: the rival's crest drops onto the pitch above the player, a line snaps to his card and reels him in, and the crest flies off with him. A green ticker names the move, and his empty shirt keeps the crest of where he went. Three in a row, then the same summary.
